convention.note: Snake/kebab case, lowercase. Wildcards prohibited in production seeds — individual rows per permission for auditing. Some 4-part codes are intentional (e.g. cad.vendedor.comissao.config) when a resource has natural sub-resources.

modules.name: Gesture Detection (Edge)
modules.description: Webcam capture, facial landmark extraction and multi-class classification of the active command (simple gesture or compound of multiple primitives), executed locally on the patient's device.

modules.name: Events and Alarms
modules.description: Generation of the structured event matching the recognized command, orchestration of notification by urgency level (full-screen alarm for emergency; discreet for routine) and routing to the guardian.

modules.name: Patients and Command Catalog
modules.description: Patient registration and command catalog (gesture -> action, free-form label defined by the family, sensitivity, minimum/maximum gesture time and urgency level), independently calibratable per command.

modules.name: Caregivers and Access
modules.description: Management of caregivers/users, roles and links to patient(s); basis of the multi-tenant model (tenant = family or clinic).

modules.name: History and Audit Trail
modules.description: Immutable record of events, alarms and confirmation/edit actions, with an audit trail.

modules.name: Dashboard and Notifications
modules.description: Web dashboard (Angular) for the caregiver to review history, calibrate sensitivity and receive notifications.

modules.name: Edge Device Integration
modules.description: Registration, pairing and heartbeat monitoring of the local (edge) agent that runs gesture detection.

modules.name: Conversation via Speech Tree
modules.description: Speech tree navigable by category → phrase, with an input-channel-agnostic design (gesture via GEST or direct touch/mouse). The runtime uses pure retrieval (Elasticsearch/kNN) for assisted semantic search; voice output via pre-synthesized, cached TTS audio (ElevenLabs, the patient's voice); English-only content.

modules.name: AI-Assisted Training (Speech Tree Authoring)
modules.description: Phase separate from the daily use of CONV: an LLM (Claude/Anthropic) converses with the caregiver and the patient (collaborative flow, dual authorization) to propose new categories/phrases; approved content is indexed in Elasticsearch and has audio synthesized via ElevenLabs. It does not take part in the patient's communication runtime.

$comment: Ships ONLY the modules of framework LAYERS, never a client's bounded contexts (D-103 Gap B, D-584). `gro` is here because the growth layer is a framework capability any project can enable (growth.enabled, D-332..D-337) and /gr-architect-admin-module scaffolds against it. A client's own modules go in arch/overrides/permission-catalogue.partial.json via the D-074 deep-merge; see _examples/ for ready-to-copy catalogues (eerripe, candeeiro-so, neuroassist-ai).
